meta.title: VLOG和手绘动画文字真的绝配！一步步教会你
meta.title_en: Vlogs and Hand-Drawn Animated Text Are a Perfect Match! Step by Step

scenes.title_cn: 开场：如何制作这样的手绘动画文字？让…
scenes.title_en: Opening: how do you make hand-drawn animat…
sentences: 让我们省略多余的开场白，直接进入详细教程。
Let's skip the intro and dive right into the tutorial.
skip the intro（省略开场白）
你需要一台可以使用Apple Pencil的iPad，以及一个付费软件Procreate。
You need an Apple Pencil-capable iPad and the paid app Procreate.
Apple Pencil + Procreate
scenes.speak: Let's skip the intro and dive right into the tutorial. You need an Apple Pencil-capable iPad and the paid app Procreate.

scenes.title_en: Writing in Procreate: open Procreate and c…
scenes.context: 动画协助+图层描字+方块空心字。
sentences: 画布的尺寸可以设置成跟你视频一样的，比如1080P就设置成1920x1080。
Match the canvas size to your video—for 1080p, use 1920x1080.
match the size（同尺寸）
在组合里找到小扳手，找到画布，把这个动画协助打开。
Find the wrench icon, open Canvas, and turn on Animation Assist.
animation assist（动画协助）
顺着笔画描成方块感觉的空心字，最后再填色。
Trace into blocky hollow letters along the strokes, then fill them.
blocky hollow letters（方块空心字）
scenes.speak: Match the canvas size to your video—for 1080p, use 1920x1080. Find the wrench icon, open Canvas, and turn on Animation Assist. Trace into blocky hollow letters along the strokes, then fill them.

scenes.title_cn: 导出动画：接下来需要做的是让它拥有动…
scenes.title_en: Exporting the animation: next, make it mov…
scenes.context: 三个图层复制成九帧导出透明GIF。
sentences: 新建两个图层，每个图层各把刚刚写的字描一遍，获得三个笔迹略有不同的图层。
Create two more layers, each tracing the words, for three slightly different versions.
three versions（三份笔迹）
可以故意粗糙一点，这样最终生成的动画抖抖感会更强一些。
Trace rougher on purpose for a stronger shaking feel.
rougher shake（粗糙抖抖感）
直接选这个动画GIF，这样导出来的素材就是透明底的。
Pick animated GIF—the export has a transparent background.
transparent GIF（透明底GIF）
scenes.speak: Create two more layers, each tracing the words, for three slightly different versions. Trace rougher on purpose for a stronger shaking feel. Pick animated GIF—the export has a transparent background.

scenes.title_cn: PR湍流置换法：如果你觉得描两遍太麻…
scenes.context: 湍流置换+色调分离时间实现逐帧抖动。
sentences: 把字导出为一张PNG的图片，然后把这张图放到你的视频上面。
Export the word as a PNG and lay it over your video.
single PNG（单张PNG）
把数量改成10，在演化开头打一个关键帧，最后把演化的数值猛拉大。
Set Amount to 10, keyframe Evolution at the start, then crank it up.
turbulent displace（湍流置换）
把这个24改成6或者9，这样整个嵌套就变成6帧或者9帧了。
Change 24 to 6 or 9, and the nest becomes 6 or 9 frames.
posterize time（色调分离时间）
scenes.speak: " Set Amount to 10, keyframe Evolution at the start, then crank it up. Change 24 to 6 or 9, and the nest becomes 6 or 9 frames.

scenes.title_cn: 无iPad的纸笔方案：如果你没有iP…
scenes.title_en: No-iPad paper method: without an iPad ther…
scenes.context: 纸笔描三遍拍照成动画。
sentences: 用马克笔写出你要放在视频的文字，注意笔触要粗一点。
Write with a marker, making the strokes thick.
thick strokes（粗笔触）
把写好的字贴在窗户上，再盖上另一张白纸，把字描一遍。
Stick the paper on a window, cover with another sheet, and trace the words.
trace on glass（贴窗描字）
把这三张照片导进剪辑软件里，一般是每张三帧左右，多复制几组首尾相连。
Import the three photos, about three frames each, and chain duplicates end to end.
three frames each（每张三帧）
scenes.speak: Write with a marker, making the strokes thick. Stick the paper on a window, cover with another sheet, and trace the words. Import the three photos, about three frames each, and chain duplicates end to end.

scenes.title_cn: 变亮变暗与改色：接下来我们只要把这张…
scenes.title_en: Screen-mix and recoloring: nest the image,…
scenes.context: 变暗=透明黑字，变亮=镂空，PS抠字改色。
sentences: 选择变暗，它就会变成透明底的黑色文字动画。
Choose Darken for transparent-background black text.
darken blend（变暗混合）
如果混合模式选择变亮的话，就会变成这种镂空的效果。
Choose Lighten instead for a hollow cutout effect.
lighten hollow（变亮镂空）
把写好的照片先导进PS里把字抠出来，然后就可以用PR里的颜色工具给它改颜色了。
Cut the letters out in Photoshop, then recolor them with Premiere's color tools.
recolor the text（改文字颜色）
scenes.speak: Choose Darken for transparent-background black text. Choose Lighten instead for a hollow cutout effect. Cut the letters out in Photoshop, then recolor them with Premiere's color tools.

practice: iPad with Apple Pencil and paid app Procreate.
Match canvas size to your video resolution.
Write, trace into blocky hollow letters, fill color.
Three traced layers × 3 = nine-frame animated GIF.
Turbulent Displace + Posterize Time for jitter.
pitfalls: Trace three slightly different versions of the word.
逐帧画太累，描三遍更高效。
Trace rougher for a stronger shaking feel.
Pick Posterize instead of Posterize Time.
Choose Posterize Time and change 24 to 6 or 9.
要选色调分离时间而非色调分离。
Combine turbulence displacement and paper tracing.
shifts: 用 hand-drawn text（手写动画文字）、animation assist（动画协助）、transparent GIF（透明GIF）
用 blocky hollow letters（方块空心字）、rough strokes（粗糙笔迹）、shake effect（抖抖感）
用 turbulent displace（湍流置换）、posterize time（色调分离时间）、blend mode（混合模式）
